name: dot-plugins
description: Agent plugins packaged to the Agent Plugins Specification v1.0.0.

plugins.name: agent-plugin-builder
plugins.description: Authoring and conformance tooling for the Agent Plugins Specification v1.0.0: scaffolds plugin.json, skills/, and mcp.json, and verifies them with a bundled validator.

plugins.name: pstack
plugins.description: if you want to go fast, go deep first. pstack helps you write less, but higher quality code. rigorous agent workflows you can parallelize with confidence.

plugins.name: ontology-forge
plugins.description: Design and extend a Palantir Foundry ontology the domain-driven way: interview the domain, shape object types, links, interfaces and actions, then map source data and logic onto them.

plugins.name: swarm-forge
plugins.description: Disciplined tmux-based agent orchestration: pick a pack of specialist agents, give each its own git worktree, and drive them from a local web cockpit.

plugins.name: swarm-forge-squad
plugins.description: The SwarmForge squad workflow: a persistent squad leader that spawns short-lived specialist workers on demand, each bound by a capability contract.

plugins.name: domain-mapping
plugins.description: Discover business domains through EventStorming, evidence, recursive questions, and conformance checks.
